why_ai: Parts still have to be identified, stocked and driven to plants within hours, and plants pay for the people who know their machines, though order entry and quoting are being automated fast.
why_clarity: One right part per request, checked when it fits, recurs thousands of times a day, but identification is done by feel and varies by rep.
why_digital: Requests arrive as emails, calls and worn parts, the work runs through branches and warehouses, and the product is physical, sold through local branches and national contracts.

why_ai: Onsite reps, storerooms and the account relationship carry the contract, while the savings paperwork around it automates.
why_clarity: Savings and compliance are measurable, but each contract's baseline is argued and judged at re-bid years later.
why_digital: Punchout and vending are digital, but supply, onsite service and the relationship are physical and local.

why_ai: Rotating equipment keeps wearing out in physical plants, and application engineering on site stays with people.
why_clarity: Fit and failure are checkable, but application judgement varies by specialist.
why_digital: Physical components delivered to plants by local branches, with catalogues online.

why_ai: Identification from worn parts is learnable, but delivery inside the downtime window and the plant's trust in the branch stay local and physical.
why_clarity: There is one right part and the machine either runs or not within hours, though veterans identify by feel.
why_digital: Worn parts and photos come in, matching happens on screen, and a physical part goes out from a nearby branch.

why_ai: Sensors and models detect faults, but diagnosis on difficult machines and root-cause work on site need experienced people.
why_clarity: Alerts are many and similar, but whether a call was right shows up weeks later at teardown, if it is recorded at all.
why_digital: Signals are digital and analysed remotely, while installation, routes and teardown are on site.

why_ai: Hoses are identified, cut, crimped and tested by hand at a counter or in a van, and machines keep needing them.
why_clarity: A built hose fits and holds pressure or it does not, immediately, though fitting identification is learned by touch and eye.
why_digital: A failed hose comes in by hand and a built assembly goes out the same way, from a local counter.

why_digital: Agreements, invoices and claims are all documents and portal submissions.

why_ai: Small houses survive on local relationships and breakdown service, though national sites and AI tools erode their catalogue business.

why_digital: Phone, email and counter sales of physical goods to nearby plants, on old systems.

why_ai: Forecasting and routing automate, but bins are installed and refilled by hand inside customers' plants.
